messages:
elaine: heads up — embeddings service in eu-west1 is hitting 503s for a subset of requests. root cause looks like the new batching fallback race. i have a hotfix ready that reverts the fallback and tightens kv-cache ttl. can we fast-track a canary pin + prod deploy in the next 20m?

deploy-bot: @elaine submitted hotfix branch hotfix/revert-batch-fallback -> build 782. All CI + unit checks passed. integration tests running (ETA ~4m). link: https://ci.internal/782

jordan: quick q — does this change affect embeddings scoring determinism? need to know for release notes and regression windows.

elaine: no scoring changes, just fallback gating and cache ttl. output semantics unchanged. tests assert identical outputs for sample set.

ops-bot: emergency deploy policy triggered: request marked P1 -> expedited-approval required from 2 on-call leads. Also running traffic shadowing to canary.

sam: i can +1 and be on-call during rollout. i want strict rollback criteria: if 503 rate >0.5% in canary for 10m -> immediate rollback.

jordan: +1 from me, can monitor traces and p99 latency. will watch kv-cache hit/miss. :thumbsup:

elaine: thanks — plan: canary (5% eu-west1) -> 15m observ window -> if green, promote to 100% with 10m watch. rollback cmd: `/deploy rollback 782 --to-tag v1.2.1` and emergency-terminate: `/deploy terminate 782`.

deploy-bot: Preflight results: security checks OK. canary infra available. automatic canary ramps enabled. patch pinned as v1.2.3-hotfix.

releasebot: note: release notes stub created by @morgan at https://notes/release/v1.2.3-hotfix — please add brief description of impact and rollback criteria.

morgan: adding notes now — will include affected endpoints and mitigation steps. cutting one-line public blurb for status page: "We’re deploying a hotfix to reduce 503s for embeddings in EU; no user-visible data change."

sam: approved. i'm available for rollback window. :eyes:

jordan: approved, watching logs. starting traces dashboard now.

elaine: initiating canary deploy now. calling it out: /deploy promote 782 --env canary --pin v1.2.3-hotfix

deploy-bot: Canary started: 5% eu-west1. rollout id 782-canary. live tarball: s3://releases/782/v1.2.3-hotfix.tar.gz

ops-bot: monitoring configured: alerts on 5xxs, p95/p99 latency, kv-cache miss spike. alert hooks -> #incidents + pager.

jordan: initial 2m sample — 503s dropped to 0.2% (previously ~2.3%). p99 latency stable.

sam: looks good from my side, no error spikes. hold 15m then promote if still green.

elaine: thanks everyone. if anything spikes, rollback criteria agreed. will post final promote command here. :rocket:
